meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据简报灵活创作多场景视频作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作多场景视频或品牌短片
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit multi-scene video compositions from a brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to produce multi-scene videos or brand reels

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能创建或修改较长的多场景视频。它先检查项目状态，再制定计划、加载素材，按蓝图构建各场景，产出完整HyperFrames项目。
howto.when: 当你要制作或编辑较长的多场景视频（如品牌片、蒙太奇、静态循环等），且没有更专门的工作流可用时触发；或当项目BRIEF.md将流程标记为companion时。

say.text: 帮我把这些素材做成一个30秒的产品宣传片。
say.note: Claude会检查项目状态并开始构建多场景视频。

say.text: 给这个视频改一下第三个场景的转场效果。
say.note: 作为具体修改，Claude会直接编辑并保留原有决策。

say.text: 我想做一个静态标题卡放在视频开头。
say.note: 这是该技能支持的创作类型，Claude会按流程生成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create or edit longer multi-scene HyperFrames video compositions. It checks project state, plans, loads media assets, builds scenes from blueprints, and produces a complete video project.
howto.when_en: Triggered when creating or editing a longer multi-scene video (e.g., brand reels, montages, static loops) with no specialized workflow, or when BRIEF.md sets flow to companion.

say_en.text: Assemble these clips into a 30-second product promo.
say_en.note: Claude will check project state and start building the multi-scene video.

say_en.text: Change the transition of scene 3 in this video.
say_en.note: As a specific edit, Claude will apply it and keep existing decisions.

say_en.text: I want a static title card at the start of the video.
say_en.note: This is a supported type; Claude will generate it per the workflow.
